title: Space Geometry
tagline: Build in 3-D space — solids, points, vectors
privacy: Privacy: no sign-up and no personal details are collected; typed instructions (math text only) are kept for a few days with an anonymous visitor id — your IP address is never stored.
aboutLead: A tool for building the figure of a space-geometry question: enter the givens line by line — solids, points, vectors — and the figure builds and orbits in front of you. It draws and verifies the givens; it never solves the question.

err.notOnPlane: '{{id}}' is not on any of the given planes — check the givens
err.notCoplanar: The points of plane {{id}} do not determine a single plane — check the givens
err.planeSideUndefined: Plane {{id}} is vertical — it has no "above" or "below"
err.wrongSideOfPlane: '{{id}}' is not on the stated side of the plane — check the givens
err.notOnLine: '{{id}}' is not on the line — check the givens
err.symbolicNewPoint: A new point '{{id}}' needs numeric coordinates — letters are only allowed for a point already in the figure
err.injectionUnsatisfiable: No placement of the solid matches the given coordinates — check the givens
err.givensContradict: The givens contradict each other — no figure satisfies «{{stated}}» together with {{others}}
err.givensContradictAlone: The givens contradict each other — no figure satisfies «{{stated}}» together with the rest of the givens
err.signUnsatisfiable: No solution satisfies the stated coordinate sign of '{{id}}'
err.noSuchSolid: The figure doesn't have exactly one '{{id}}' — the claim is ambiguous
err.freeSizeClaim: The '{{id}}' has no stated sizes — give a radius/height before a volume or area claim
err.twoUnknowns: A vector relation may define only one unknown point ('{{id}}' is a second)
err.lineMissesPlane: The line is parallel to the plane at the chosen parameter value — no crossing point '{{id}}'
err.sizeOnSolid: A numeric size on a free-dimension solid isn't supported here yet
err.boundUnsatisfiable: No configuration of the figure puts the angle at {{id}} inside the stated bound
err.incircleNeedsTriangle: An inscribed circle can only be drawn in a triangle — a general quadrilateral has none.
err.claimRefuted: The claim doesn't hold in the figure — check the computation
err.placementNotFixed: The figure’s position relative to the coordinate system is not fixed yet, so a statement about the axes cannot be checked — state a placing given first (a point’s coordinates, or a base lying on a coordinate plane)
err.vacuousRelation: The relation names one object twice — it needs two different objects
err.badFile: This is not a valid Space Builder figure file
err.newerSchema: The file was saved by a newer version of the tool — refresh the page and try again
err.unknownSymbol: the parameter {{id}} isn't defined in the figure
err.ambiguousAngle: identifying the angle at {{id}} needs exactly two edges in the figure — name all three letters (e.g. ∠AOB = 90)
err.ambiguousVectorLength: vector or length? write vector AB = vector CD (or AB⃗ = CD⃗), or |AB| = |CD|
err.paramRolesConflated: the letter {{letter}} is used both as the running parameter (outside the parentheses) and as a component inside them — it isn't clear which you meant. Pick a different letter for the running parameter, e.g. x=t({{letter}}-1, 5-{{letter}}, -2)
err.droppedGiven: The statement was not added to the figure, because we could not draw: {{items}}. Try splitting it into shorter givens or rephrasing
err.noPrismToMakeRight: there is no prism in the figure to make right — build a prism or a parallelepiped first
err.ambiguousPrism: there is more than one prism in the figure — it's unclear which one you mean
err.planeNotDetermined: Plane {{id}} has no stated equation or orientation yet — this statement needs a determined plane. Pin it with an equation, three points on it, or a ∥/⊥ relation
err.lineNotDetermined: Line {{id}} has no determined direction or position yet — this statement needs a determined line. Pin it with two points on it, a parametric form, or a ∥/⊥ relation

scope.valueless-query: This tool draws and verifies givens — it does not solve. To act on an angle, state a value: e.g. "the angle between line AC' and plane ABCD is 30", and it will be enforced or verified.
scope.cross-app: Plane geometry (circle, rectangle, rhombus, inscribed-in-circle…) is built in the 2-D tool: themathbible.com/geo-builder. A circle IN SPACE is supported here in the form "circle centered at O tangent to line AB at B".
scope.bare-solid: A pyramid or prism needs its base: e.g. "pyramid SABCD with a square base" or "right triangular prism ABC". A cube, box or tetrahedron builds without details.
scope.ui-command: Marks appear automatically from the givens — instead of asking for a mark, state the given itself: e.g. "angle D = 90".
scope.oblique-prism: A prism not stated "right" builds oblique — the tilt is a degree of freedom, and "the prism is right" straightens it. For a pentagon or hexagon base state "right" (e.g. "right prism with a pentagon base"), since a regular base is not a stated given. If you meant an oblique prism, name its base: e.g. "prism with a triangle base".
scope.lowercase-labels: Vertex labels are written in UPPERCASE — AS, not as. Lowercase letters are reserved for vectors (u, v, w), parameters (t, k, m) and coordinates (x, y, z), and angles are named with Greek letters (α, β, γ, θ). Try: {{corrected}}
scope.ambiguous-height: A height from a single point does not say which plane to drop it onto — there are several options. Name the base or the segment: "height from D to base ABC", "height of the pyramid from D", or "CD is the altitude in triangle ABC".
scope.latin-angle-label: A lowercase latin letter is reserved here for vectors and parameters (u, v, w, t, k, m), so it cannot name an angle. Name the angle by its vertices — “∠ABC”, and “60 < ∠ABC < 90” works too — or use a Greek label from the palette: “60 < α < 90”.

load.unbuildable: The file opened, but no step could be rebuilt in this version ({{count}} steps) — it may have been saved by a newer build. The steps are kept exactly as saved.
load.partial: The file opened, but {{count}} step(s) could not be rebuilt (step {{steps}}) — they are flagged in the list. The steps are kept exactly as saved.

notice.shapeRedundant: {{ids}} is already a {{shape}} from an earlier given — the statement is true and adds no new information.
notice.baseConstrained: For the pyramid to be right, the base ({{ids}}) was constrained from a {{from}} to a {{to}}.
notice.lineCalledPlane: Note: {{line}} is a line, not a plane. Read as "plane {{ids}} is perpendicular to line {{line}}".
notice.lineRelNoun: Note: {{line}} is a line, not a plane — the relation was built against line {{line}}.
notice.redundantRelation: The relation between {{a}} and {{b}} was verified ✓ — but it already follows from their definitions, so this given adds no new information.
notice.lineAutoNamed: The name {{requested}} is already taken, so the intersection line was named {{assigned}}.
